units.name: 专项测验
units.title: 七年级上册语法综合专项测验
units.desc: 针对人教版2024新教材七年级上册核心语法的高难度变式测验，覆盖 be 动词、主格代词、一般现在时 do/does、名词所有格、There be、方位介词、连词、Wh- 疑问句、can、时间表达与序数词。

exercises.question:
— Hi, I ______ Li Hua. Are you from London?
— No, I ______ not. My parents ______ from Canada, but I ______ in Beijing now.
exercises.explanation: I 用 am；I am not 用 am；My parents 是复数，用 are；I 用 am。故选 A。易错点：受 parents 影响误把 I 后也用 are。

exercises.question:
用括号中所给动词的适当形式填空。
My cousin ______ (do) his homework every evening. ______ your sister ______ (like) reading books?
exercises.explanation: My cousin 是第三人称单数，do 变为 does；一般疑问句主语 your sister 是第三人称单数，助动词用 Does，后接动词原形 like。易错点：Does 后误用 likes。

exercises.question: This is my ______ room. It's very clean. Tom and Jack share it.
exercises.explanation: 句意为：这是我父母的房间。他们共用这个房间。parents 是以 -s 结尾的复数名词，所有格直接加 '。故选 B。易错点：误加 's 或混淆单复数。

exercises.question:
用适当的 be 动词填空。
There ______ a library and two classroom buildings in my school. The library ______ between the two buildings.
exercises.explanation: There be 遵循就近原则，靠近 be 动词的是 a library（单数），用 is；第二空主语 The library 是单数，用 is。易错点：受 two classroom buildings 影响误用 are。

options: A. Because it is interesting, I like it.
B. It is interesting, so I like it.
D. Because it is interesting, but I like it.
exercises.question:
下面句子有一处语法错误，请选择正确的句子。
Because it is interesting, so I like it.
exercises.explanation: because 和 so 不能同时出现在一个句子中。A 只用 because，B 只用 so，均正确。故选 C。逆向思维：根据错误句子反推连词规则。

exercises.question:
根据答语补全问句，每空一词。
— ______ do you like English?
— Because it is useful.
— ______ is your English teacher?
— Miss Li.
exercises.explanation: Because 回答原因，问句用 Why；Miss Li 回答人，问句用 Who。考察 Wh- 疑问词的准确选用。

options: A. She can sing well, but she can't play the piano.
B. She can sings well, but she can't play the piano.
C. She can sing well, but she can't plays the piano.
D. She can sings well, but she can't plays the piano.
exercises.question:
下面句子有一处语法错误，请选择正确的句子。
She can sings well, but she can't plays the piano.
exercises.explanation: can 和 can't 后必须接动词原形，不能加 -s。原句 sings 和 plays 均错误。故选 A。逆向思维：根据错误句子反推情态动词规则。

exercises.answer: a quarter to eight; half past nine; twelfth
exercises.question:
用英语写出下列时间或序数词。
7:45 → ______    9:30 → ______    12 → ______ (序数词)
exercises.explanation: 7:45 差一刻八点，用 a quarter to eight；9:30 九点半，用 half past nine；12 的序数词是 twelfth。考察时间表达与序数词的综合。
